title: SG-4.1 · Serve player contribution history at /api/v1/player/me/contributions
summary: Move the player contribution history route from /api/v1/contributions/mine to /api/v1/player/me/contributions
description: Context: backend/internal/server/server.go registers ch.Mine at GET /api/v1/contributions/mine. Desired behavior: the same handler is served at GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions. Expected result: the new path returns the caller history and the old path no longer routes to Mine. Why: the player API surface groups player-scoped data under /player/me.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid session cookie and round_id, when GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions is requested, then the response is 200 with a JSON array
Given a valid session cookie, when GET /api/v1/contributions/mine is requested, then it no longer reaches Mine and responds 404
Given no session cookie, when GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions is requested, then the response is 401

in_scope: Unit test for the new path in server_test.go

technical_constraints: Go chi router; reuse existing Handler.Mine
definition_of_done: New path served and old Mine route removed
